tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows show a smooth response but provide limited separation among the authorized temporal mechanisms. The slow-horizon query and damped-transient signatures make a fine trajectory batch the relevant next measurement for identifying the horizon dependence before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately resolve whether the observed response is this saturating two-parameter law or an alternative temporal mechanism.
The paid rows alone do not distinguish it confidently from other smooth horizon-dependent mechanisms.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not address the model identifiability question.
